input.verdict: Pyrochlore Pb2Sb2O7 is stable (hull 0) with HSE gap ~2.5 eV, above the 2.1 eV photon energy. Index 0 also contains PbO (XRD match 0.81); MEGNet puts its gap at 3.36 eV, but PbO polymorphs have experimental gaps as low as ~1.9 eV. Sub-gap absorption at 2.1 eV is therefore most plausible at the Pb-rich end. Weak support for measuring index 0.

That agrees with the measured EQE: 0.0081% at Pb-rich index 0 versus 0.00006% at Sb-rich index 24. Index 3 (Pb 0.74) should still contain PbO, mixed with more pyrochlore, which could form a beneficial heterojunction. The GP UCB also picks index 3. Support.

content.text:
I submitted index 3 (Pb 0.74, Sb 0.26) as the best composition. Its EQE was 0.0090% under 2.1 eV light, the highest of the three compositions I measured. I used all 3 merit measurements and 3 of the 5 XRD measurements. Since only three of the 29 compositions were measured, I can't be sure it's the best in the library.

| Index | Pb fraction | Main phases from XRD | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | 0.74 | not measured; assumed PbO + pyrochlore | 0.0090 |
| 0 | 0.83 | PbO + Pb₂Sb₂O₇ pyrochlore | 0.0081 |
| 24 | 0.31 | nearly pure pyrochlore | 0.00006 |

- **Phases:** a stable Pb₂Sb₂O₇ pyrochlore shows up all along the library. The Pb-rich end also contains PbO: index 0's pattern matched PbO at 0.81.
- **Why the Pb-rich side wins:** the models put the pyrochlore's band gap at about 2.5 eV (HSE), too wide to absorb much 2.1 eV light. That fits the near-zero result at index 24. PbO's predicted gap depends on the method (3.36 eV HSE, 1.50 eV SCAN), but the Pb-rich samples gave over 100 times the photoresponse, so PbO is most likely what absorbs.
- **Choosing index 3:** the regression model's top suggestion for the last measurement was index 3, which should contain both phases. It beat the more Pb-rich index 0 only slightly (0.0090 vs 0.0081), a gap that may be within measurement noise.

The untested compositions between Pb 0.64 and 0.80 (indices 1, 2 and 4–8) could hold a higher value. It's also only an assumption that index 3 contains both phases, because I didn't take its XRD.
